hypothesis: Changing only both tanh hidden-layer widths from 128 to 256 improves fixed-budget reconstruction and standalone control on the frozen clean executed-data benchmark.
confirmation_trigger: Task screen passes OR any final policy reaches 15/16 primary walking. Evaluate ALL six final policies on the disjoint confirmation panel; no best checkpoint/seed selection.
stopping: Exactly six fresh 10000-update fits, fixed 10k endpoint. Retain every failed episode and partial attempt. Stop on provenance, interface, runtime, budget, wall or storage error; no retry, extra seeds, best checkpoint, longer fit, new data, further teacher acquisition or coupling round.
uncertainty: Three paired training seeds are the intervention replication units. Reset panels are shared and paired. Report all seed effects and a paired crossed seed/reset descriptive bootstrap; do not count 48 episodes or frames as 48 independent training runs. Development thresholds are screening conventions, not power calculations.
claim_scope: Width intervention under a fixed update/row budget and fan-in initialization rule. Wider networks use more parameters/FLOPs; no equal-compute, universal capacity, teachability or coupling-convergence claim. Historical L1 is not a matched control.
